turns.prompt_text: give me the difference between USB 3
turns.response_html:
USB 3.0 (now often called USB 3.2 Gen 1) introduced 5 Gbps transfer speeds, roughly ten times faster than USB 2.0. It is physically distinguished by blue plastic inside the connectors and five additional pins for "SuperSpeed" data transfer.

Key Iterations of USB 3

NameMax SpeedCommon Branding
USB 3.0 / 3.1 Gen 15 GbpsSuperSpeed
USB 3.1 Gen 210 GbpsSuperSpeed+
USB 3.2 Gen 2x220 GbpsSuperSpeed 20Gbps
